hard_constraint_1_run_capped_seam.evidence: git diff on scripts/lib/agent-output.sh is empty (file untouched). scripts/lib/agent-suite-run.sh is a new, separate file, sourced by scripts/agent-test.sh only. run_capped's return "$rc", 200-line output cap and spill-file behavior are all byte-identical to baseline.
hard_constraint_1_run_capped_seam.subtlety_documented: run_capped's own body unconditionally re-enables `set -e` before its final `return "$rc"`. A caller wrapping the call in `set +e; run_capped ...; rc=$?; set -e` does NOT prevent an abort, because errexit is evaluated against the state active at the moment of `return`, which run_capped itself just reset to ON. Empirically proven (see scratch traces during this session). The working fix, used by run_suite, is the standard errexit exemption: `rc=0; run_capped "$label" "$@" || rc=$?`. Documented at length in scripts/lib/agent-suite-run.sh's header comment and in test arm B's comment.

Separately (and independently), the test's own tier-name list has t4/t5 swapped relative to the actual job names: the test checks 't4-engine'/'t5-embedder' but the real jobs are 'publish-rust-t4-embedder' / 'publish-rust-t5-engine' (release.yml documents this ordering was deliberately fixed in 0.7.2 PR-4 so embedder resolves on the index before engine depends on it). Both observations are reported here for Slice 40 / the HITL disposition decision; neither was touched.
